meta.title: Project activity board
meta.description: One board for recent work across every workspace project. For each project it reads its Git repository read-only and shows the current branch, commits in a 7/14/30-day window, a per-day commit histogram, the latest commit, upstream ahead/behind counts, and uncommitted changes with their file list. Workspaces that are not Git repositories still appear with their DSH session count, and the bottom timeline merges recent commits from all repositories so work committed by other agents or editors shows up in the same place. Open it from the board icon in the sidebar panel-icon list, next to Plugins and Schedules; it refreshes every 30 seconds and never writes to a repository. The same data also appears inside a session: a status line under the composer shows the current project branch, uncommitted count and latest commit (expandable, with a link to the board), and the New Session row carries a compact branch/uncommitted chip. Clicking either one opens a detail tab in the right sidebar with the project branch, changed files, daily commit histogram and commit history, plus a way back to the full board. Hide any project you do not need to follow from its card header; hidden projects drop out of the overview and the timeline, and the N-hidden control beside the Projects heading restores them one by one or all at once (the list lives on the host in $DSH_HOME/git-activity/hidden.json; delete that file to clear it). Requires Git on PATH; if git is unavailable the cards report the error instead of a commit list.
